title: The 4Ps of innovation
caption: Innovation is not only new products. It can change how things are made, where and to whom they are sold, or the whole business model.
alt: Four boxes: product innovation (a new phone), process (automated warehouses), position (repositioning a drink as a sports product), paradigm (low-cost airlines).
description: Product: changes in what is offered, such as a new phone.
Process: changes in how it is made or delivered, such as automated warehouses.
Position: changes in context or market, such as repositioning a drink as a sports product.
Paradigm: changes in the underlying business model, such as low-cost airlines.
